At Honeywell Aerospace, you’ll become a member of a global team as the Senior Data Analytics, working to shape the future of technology, security, and operational excellence. Honeywell Aerospace Internal Audit offers a fast-paced, high-energy environment for professionals to develop problem-solving skills, gain cross-functional experience, and prepare for success across the company.
Key Responsibilities
+ Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and models across platforms such as EDW, OneStream, ServiceNow, Power BI, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Databricks).
+ Develop reusable audit analytics and dashboards (e.g., anomaly detection, process mining, control effectiveness analytics) to provide near real-time visibility and continuous risk monitoring.
+ Integrate advanced AI-powered anomaly detection and predictive analytics into audit processes to proactively identify emerging risks, fraud patterns, and control weaknesses across business operations
+ Develop and deploy generative AI solutions (e.g., large language models, intelligent agents) to automate audit documentation, evidence synthesis, and reporting, improving audit cycle speed and consistency while enabling auditors to focus on strategic analysis
+ Partner with auditors to embed analytics and support for all internal audits; translate risk and control objectives into measurable data tests.
+ Apply statistical techniques and machine learning methods to large datasets to identify patterns, control deviations, and emerging risk signals.
+ Establish data quality, governance, and documentation standards for audit data products; maintain a catalogue of datasets, queries, and visualizations.
+ Advance automation (e.g., Python/R scripts, Alteryx/ADF flows, DAX/Power Query) to streamline evidence gathering and testing procedures.
+ Coach and upskill the Internal Audit team on analytics tools and methods; promote best practices and lead enablement sessions.
+ Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, IT, Cybersecurity, and business operations to source data, validate logic, and operationalize insights.
+ Plan and execute targeted IT/Cyber audit procedures leveraging analytics outputs to evaluate governance, technology, and operational controls.
+ Assess enterprise risk management related to IT/Cyber domains, including cloud security, access management, application security, and data governance.
+ Support compliance audits and assessments (SOX, CMMC, GDPR, DFARS, ITAR) by designing data-driven tests and producing clear, evidence-backed reports.
+ Lead and execute independent audit reviews, evaluating governance, technology, and operational controls across diverse domains, with a primary focus on IT and Cyber risk areas.
+ Contribute to reviews of integrated supply chain and Industrial Control Systems (IEC 62443), where applicable, using data-led approaches.
+ Participate in technology diligence and integration for M&A and joint ventures, focusing on data and control environments.
You must have
+ Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or related field.
+ Minimum of 4–5 years of experience in data analytics/engineering or audit analytics within Internal Audit, Risk, Compliance, or Technology functions.
+ Advanced proficiency in SQL and one or more of: Python or R; strong experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT (e.g., Alteryx, Azure Data Factory), and version control (Git).
+ Hands-on experience with data visualization and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) including DAX, Power Query, and dashboard design best practices.
+ Experience with enterprise systems and data sources (ServiceNow, EDW, OneStream, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse).
+ Working knowledge of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques for classification, regression, anomaly detection, and time series.
+ Strong verbal and written communication skills; capable of stakeholder interviews, executive-ready storytelling, and translating technical analyses into audit findings.
We value
+ A growth mindset with curiosity to learn business processes and become a trusted analytics partner to auditors and leaders.
+ Experience embedding analytics into global audits and continuous auditing programs.
+ Project/program management capabilities to prioritize, deliver, and govern a portfolio of analytics use cases.
+ Exposure to cybersecurity and IT risk frameworks (NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001/2, OWASP, IEC 62443) and related regulatory environments (DFARS, ITAR, GDPR).
+ Experience with SIEM and security analytics platforms (e.g., Splunk) and enterprise tooling (e.g., SailPoint, Wiz, Tanium, Rapid7, Nozomi) is a plus.
+ Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, Certified Analytics Professional, or Microsoft/AWS/Azure data/analytics certifications are advantageous.
+ Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and communicate complex technical topics with clarity across diverse teams.
+ Experience with enterprise IT & Cyber automation and analytics systems (ServiceNow, Nagios, Tanium, Rapid7, Splunk/SIEM, Nozomi/Asset Detection, Wiz/Cloud Security, SailPoint/Access Management).
+ Experience in evaluating network deployment, server management, cloud deployment, data governance, application security, SDLC, and related technology domains.
Pay transparency
The annual base salary range for this position is $84,800-$105,900. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell Aerospace considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
Benefits
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
+ Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
+ Short-term and long-term disability coverage
+ 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
+ Employee assistance program and educational assistance
+ Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
+ Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time
Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
About Honeywell Aerospace
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

**Overview**  
  

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation that time working will regularly take place inside and outside of a company office: NC, AZ

This role is responsible for partnering with business, technology, data governance, and source system teams to support the onboarding, analysis, and integration of enterprise data into the MDM platform The individual will contribute to ensuring source data is accurately profiled, mapped, standardized, governed, and integrated to support trusted master data across customer, organization, and reference data domains.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, foundational data management expertise, and the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology teams to deliver high-quality data onboarding and integration delivery.

  
**Responsibilities & Qualifications**  
  

**Support Data Ingestion and Source Onboarding**

* Support onboarding activities for new source systems into enterprise Master Data Management platforms.
* Analyze source system data structures and business processes to understand integration requirements.
* Participate in data discovery, profiling, and source assessment activities.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documentation and transformation requirements.
* Support definition and validation of data standardization, matching, survivorship, hierarchy, and integration rules.
* Identify data quality concerns, onboarding issues, and assist with remediation planning.

**Perform Data Analysis and Data Quality Assessments**

* Conduct data profiling and analysis to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, and conformity of incoming data.
* Investigate data quality issues and support root cause analysis activities.
* Assist in defining and monitoring data quality rules, controls, metrics, and KPIs.
* Analyze ingestion exceptions and support implementation of process improvements.
* Participate in validation, reconciliation, and testing activities during project delivery and production support.

**Partner with Business and Technology Stakeholders**

* Collaborate with business users, Product Owners, Architects, Tech Leads, and Engineering teams to understand data requirements.
* Document business requirements, functional specifications, and data mapping requirements.
* Participate in design, requirements gathering workshops, stakeholder discussions.
* Ensure recommendations align with enterprise data standards and governance policies for MDM Sources.
* Present findings, analysis results, and recommendations to project teams and stakeholders.

**Support Data Governance and Reference Data Management**

* Ensure compliance with enterprise data standards and MDM-related reference data requirements.
* Work with Data Governance teams and source system owners to support data stewardship and ownership processes.
* Contribute to maintenance of data definitions, business definitions, onboarding standards , metadata and documentation activities.

**Support MDM Operations and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve source onboarding processes, controls, and data quality outcomes.
* Support operational activities, release validation, and production issue analysis.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives across data onboarding and integration functions.
* Support knowledge sharing

Qualifications:  
Minimum Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's Degree and 4 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 8 years' experience in Data Management, Financial Analysis, or similar

**Preferred Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in Data Management, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Integration, Business Analysis, or Master Data Management.
* 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise MDM initiatives.
* Experience working with source system onboarding and data integration projects.
* Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements.
* Strong SQL skills for data analysis, profiling, reconciliation, and validation.
* Experience with source-to-target mapping and business rule documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and using Jira.
* Banking or financial services industry experience.
* Experience with Informatica MDM or other MDM platforms such as Reltio, Semarchy, IBM MDM, Oracle MDM, or SAP MDG.

* Experience with Customer, Party, Organization, Product, or Reference Data domains.
* Familiarity with integration technologies such as Informatica IDMC, PowerCenter, SSIS, Denodo, or equivalent ETL platforms.
* Knowledge of Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, and tools such as Collibra or R360.
* Familiarity with KYC, Customer Lifecycle Management, and Enterprise Customer Data initiatives.
* Experience supporting Data Quality monitoring and remediation initiatives.

**Key Competencies**

**Data Management**

* **Master Data Management (MDM) , SQL**
* **Data Quality:** Data Profiling, Data Analysis, Data Quality Monitoring
* **Data Governance:** Metadata Management, Reference Data Management
* **Source-to-Target Mapping, Data Integration, Data Validation and Reconciliation**
* **JIRA, SCRUM**

**Other Competencies**

* Requirements Gathering and Documentation
* Root Cause Analysis, Process Improvement
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Communication and Presentation Skills
* Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
* Working Effectively in Cross\-Functional Teams
